title: Finally fills the empty front
text: Chelsea started the season with no front-of-shirt sponsor and have now put Circle's USDC on it. Not rated yet.

source.name: Score and Change, Overview of the 2026/2027 Premier League sponsors

title: GAC on the sleeve
text: Villarreal added the carmaker GAC as Official Sleeve Partner for 2026/27, with the option to extend to 2027/28. Not rated yet.

source.name: GAC Spain, GAC patrocinador oficial de Villarreal CF

title: Sleeve filled eleven days after the front emptied
text: Eleven days after terminating Polymarket, Lazio announced kaiyunsports.news as Official Sleeve Sponsor for the 2026/27 and 2027/28 Serie A seasons. The front of the shirt remains without a sponsor. Not rated yet.

source.name: S.S. Lazio - S.S. Lazio and kaiyunsports.news announce a two-season partnership
source.quote: S.S. Lazio is pleased to announce a new partnership with kaiyunsports.news, which will become the Club’s Official Sleeve Sponsor for the 2026/27 and 2027/28 Serie A seasons

title: Polymarket front ends after four months
text: Italy's ADM blacklisted Polymarket in July 2026 for taking bets without a licence. Lazio removed the branding and terminated on 11 August, leaving the shirt blank for the new season.

title: Renews Emirates until 2033
text: Reportedly up to $93m a season, from an airline owned by the Government of Dubai.

title: Visit Rwanda goes on the front
text: Up to $27m a year from the Government of Rwanda. It replaces a betting sponsor after the ban.

title: Record Emirates renewal
text: Until 2031, reportedly $115m a year: the biggest shirt deal in Europe.

title: Saudi-owned Sela is off the front
text: A drinks brand replaces it. noon, part-owned by the same Saudi state fund, stays on the sleeve.

title: Visit Rwanda comes off the sleeve
text: Gone after eight seasons of fan protest. Emirates stays on the front, so still stained.

title: Turkish Airlines from 2027/28
text: Replaces Standard Chartered. The airline is part-owned by Türkiye’s wealth fund. We are checking it now.

title: Bitpanda moves from Premium Partner to the back of the shirt
text: Bitpanda, AC Milan's Premium Partner and Official Crypto Trading Partner since summer 2024, became the men's first team's Back-of-Shirt sponsor from the derby against Inter, joining the club's Principal Partners.

source.name: AC Milan, 'AC MILAN AND BITPANDA EXPAND PARTNERSHIP WITH NEW BACK OF SHIRT SPONSORSHIP'
source.quote: Starting from today, Bitpanda will serve as the new Back-of-Shirt sponsor for the men's First Team , joining AC Milan's family of Principal Partners .

title: Schalke foiled over Gazprom mid-season
text: Schalke ended a 15-year Gazprom deal days after the invasion of Ukraine and covered the logo with Vivawest, initially a deal to the end of the season.

source.name: FC Schalke 04, VIVAWEST become new partner
